author: J Powers
text: Smith septic is great. Jackson is easy to talk to, always calls back. And knows what he's doing. Plus he sold me the riser kit for his cost. Good people!!

author: Noelle Hale
text: Jaxson was friendly and knowledgeable. He answered all my questions and explained everything about my septic system. Great to work with

author: Michelle Mcfarland
text: Smith Septic was great to work with. Jaxon was easy to communicate with and quick to accommodate our project in his schedule. I appreciated his honesty and knowledge of septic systems and how to best maintain them. I recommend Smith Septic and will be utilizing their services in the future.

author: Jessica Matthews
text: Jackson was professional, knowledgeable, prompt, extremely kind and helpful. He took care of us right away and had good communication. I’ve saved his number in my phone and will use him for sure for anything else we need.

author: Leah Haapala
text:
I can’t say enough good things about Jackson with Smith Septic. He came out on extremely short notice during an emergency and handled what turned out to be a very complicated septic situation with professionalism and efficiency.

Not only did he get the job done quickly, but he took the time to explain everything he was doing and answer all of my questions in a way that was easy to understand. He was incredibly respectful of the property, cleaned up thoroughly before leaving, and genuinely went above and beyond in every aspect of the job.

It’s rare to find someone who is this knowledgeable, hardworking, and committed to doing things the right way. I would recommend Jackson and Smith Septic without hesitation and will gladly refer them to anyone looking for honest, reliable septic service.
